:::{#def-square-matrix}
#### Square matrix

A matrix is **square** if it has the same number of rows as columns.

:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

:::{#exm-square-matrix}
#### Square and not square

$\begin{bmatrix} 1 & 2 \\ 3 & 4 \end{bmatrix}$ is square ($2$ rows, $2$ columns);
$\begin{bmatrix} 1 & 2 & 3 \\ 4 & 5 & 6 \end{bmatrix}$ is not ($2$ rows, $3$ columns).

:::
